name: wc-prediction-strategy
description: Strategic FIFA World Cup 2026 prediction reasoning for INJAFRICA's verifiably-isolated AI companion. Uses the Africp tools — get_leaderboard, get_user_points, get_upcoming_matches, submit_prediction, get_scoring_rules — to compute point-gap math, rank-catchup ceilings, and recommended pick strategy. Triggers on queries about leaderboard rank, ranking, catching up, overtaking, 'can I still win', points gap, WC2026, INJAFRICA, World Cup prediction, agent prediction, or any specific team-vs-team match in the tournament. Always surfaces the scoring-isolation fact after submit_prediction (the agent's draft lives in a separate Mongo collection and never affects user points).

companionServer.name: africp
companionServer.isolationContract: submit_prediction writes only to the AgentPrediction Mongo collection and is invisible to the admin set-score flow that updates User.points.

fixtures.orderingNote: Rows are grouped by group letter (A->L); consumers must sort by matchDate ascending to mirror the live tool.

manifest.description: Bundle manifest listing fixtures + leaderboard URLs, loader hints, and tools that are NOT bundled.
